summary: Listed at Wavell on the same Ontario still-standing list (MNR ladder removal, no climbing); no source describes the site today.

access.note: The list says the MNR removed the bottom 20 ft of ladder and asks visitors not to climb. It does not say whether the site is open to the public.

facts.status_note: Listed as still standing on an Ontario list kept unchanged after 2013. The MNR decided in 2013 to remove many such towers; no source confirms this one stands today.

notes_for_editor: Only two list pages support this story, and they give no build year, height, design or staffing history, so the story is short. The list was kept unchanged after the 2013 MNR decision, so its still-standing label is not a current check. The brief's agency line (Department of Lands and Forests, to 1972) is not in the pages read, so the MNR named in the list is used instead. The access level 'restricted' reflects the ladder removal and the climbing request only. A Lakehead University digital collection holds 1932 and 1961 fire photos of Wavell Lake, but they do not mention a tower and were not linked to this record. Suggested checks: Ontario MNR tower decommissioning records and Wavell Township or local historical society files. Fact-check 2026-10-20: the Canada Lookouts sentence now says the index 'also lists' the name rather than 'gives' it; the author and MNR sentences were reworded to avoid copying quote wording.
